title: Model extensions config (mpi-model-extensions)
description: Load model-specific Pi extensions from rules matched against the current model. Applied at session_start and (add-only) on model_select.

enabled.description: false stops applying rules. Default true.

match.description: All present conditions must hold for the rule to apply.

missingInput.description: Every listed modality must be absent from the model's inputs.

hasInput.description: Every listed modality must be present on the model's inputs.

add.description: Extension entry paths (`~`, `$VAR`, `${VAR}` expand; relative paths are rejected) or friendly names.

remove.description: Friendly names (path basename / package dir) whose adds are dropped.
